LanguageData.RPC_BuyTraumaTeamDesc:
Pay {0} silver for {1} days of Trauma Team coverage. If this colonist goes down, a Trauma Team shuttle lands a squad that fights off whoever is hostile to them, extracts them and returns them patched up about a day later. One dispatch per coverage. Silver is taken from anywhere on the map.
Treatment is billed when the patient comes back: {2} silver per condition treated, {3} silver plus {4} per hostile if the squad had to fight, and {5} silver to cure a cyberpsycho. A bill the colony can't pay becomes debt, and Trauma Team won't help anyone until it's paid.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamNoSilver: Not enough silver on the map ({0} needed).
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamBought: {0} is covered by Trauma Team for {1} days.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamLetterText: {0} is down. Their Trauma Team coverage has kicked in: a shuttle is inbound with a squad to secure and extract them.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamExtracted: Trauma Team has extracted {0}. They'll be back in about a day.
LanguageData.RPC_CycleShellDesc: Choose which shell type the projectile launch system loads on its next reload. Shells of another type still in the magazine go back to the inventory when it reloads.
LanguageData.RPC_LauncherReloadDesc: Load {0}s from the inventory into the arm launcher ({1} carried). Shells have to be carried: add them to the pawn's loadout or have them pick some up.
LanguageData.RPC_LauncherEmpty: Launcher empty: reload it with shells from the inventory.
LanguageData.RPC_LauncherFull: The launcher is already full of that shell type.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamFailed: Trauma Team couldn't get {0} onto the shuttle. Extraction failed.
LanguageData.RPC_MaxTacLetterText: {0} is a cyberpsycho and has {1}. NCPD MaxTac is landing to put them down.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamReturnLetterText: Trauma Team has returned {0}, patched up.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaHostileLetterText: {0} attacked {1}, and Trauma Team doesn't forgive that. They are now hostile to the colony for {2} days: any squad on the ground will fight back instead of extracting its patient, their shuttle is no longer off-limits, and they won't respond to or sell coverage to any colonist until it's over. Attacking them again restarts the clock.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaForgiveLetterText: Trauma Team has taken the colony off its blacklist. Coverage can be bought again and covered colonists will be responded to.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaRefusedHostile: Trauma Team won't respond to {0}: the colony attacked them ({1} days until they'll deal with you again).
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaRefusedCoverageHostile: Trauma Team won't sell coverage to a colony that attacked them ({0} days left).
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaTeamEnemyLetterText: {0} is down, and {1} paid for Trauma Team coverage. A Trauma Team shuttle is inbound with a squad contracted to extract them. They will fight anyone in the way, colonists included.\n\nKill or capture {0} before the shuttle lands, or stop the squad carrying them aboard.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaBillPaidText:
Trauma Team has billed the colony for treating {0}. The silver was taken from the colony's stores.
{1}
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtLetterText:
Trauma Team has billed the colony for treating {0}, but there isn't enough silver to pay. The bill has been added to the colony's debt.
{1}
The colony now owes {2} silver, growing by {3}% a day. Trauma Team won't help any colonist until the debt is paid. If nothing is paid within {4} days, the debt is sold to a collection agency, and they collect in person.
Pay from any colonist's "Pay Trauma Team debt" button.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaRefusedDebt: Trauma Team won't respond to {0}: the colony owes them {1} silver.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaRefusedCoverage: Trauma Team won't sell coverage while the colony owes them {0} silver.
LanguageData.RPC_PayTraumaDebtDesc:
The colony owes Trauma Team {0} silver. Pays as much as the silver on this map covers ({4} available).
Collectors are sent in {1} days. The debt grows by {2}% a day. Paying at least {3}% of it at once restarts the deadline. Trauma Team won't help any colonist until it's paid off.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtNoSilver: No silver on the map to pay with.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtCleared: Trauma Team debt paid off. Trauma Team service is restored.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtPaidReset: Paid {0} silver to Trauma Team, {1} still owed. The collection deadline has been pushed back to {2} days.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtPaidPartial: Paid {0} silver to Trauma Team, {1} still owed. Pay at least {3}% of the debt at once to push back the collection deadline.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtWarningText: Trauma Team reminds the colony that it owes {0} silver. If the debt isn't paid within {1} days, it will be sold to a collection agency.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaDebtFinalText: Final notice: the colony owes Trauma Team {0} silver. In {1} days the debt goes to collections, and the collectors will come armed.
LanguageData.RPC_TraumaCollectorsLetterText: The colony's Trauma Team debt of {0} silver has been sold to a collection agency, and they've come to collect. They'll keep coming until the debt is paid. Paying it off makes them stand down.
